_notes.purpose: Reusable block content that appears identically (or near-identically) across homepage, category pages, and product pages. Seed these once in Directus and reuse the same block IDs across multiple pages/categories.
_notes.usage: Each shared block has a 'used_on' list showing where it appears. When seeding, create the block once, then reference its ID in the relevant page_blocks / category_blocks / product_blocks junction rows.
_notes.variations: Some blocks have minor variations (e.g. CTA headline changes per page). These are noted with 'variant_of'.
